verdict.rationale: Tailscale's mesh network keeps devices authenticated persistently, so users can SSH into a device without re-entering credentials each time (tailscale-docs-26 Tailscale SSH, tailscale-docs-7, tailscale-comm-1 'just SSH'ed into my boxes... like I'm home'). However, evidence doesn't specifically show a 'saved host' one-tap UI element (like a bookmarked host list) — this is inferred from the general zero-friction network experience, and some community reports note friction on mobile clients (tailscale-comm-14 Android connectivity issues). Missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshot of a one-tap saved-host UI on a client app, and confirmation this works consistently on mobile without re-auth prompts.
